name: retailbillingsoftware
description: Professional Retail Billing and Inventory Desktop Software

scripts.start:prod: concurrently -k -n "server,electron" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run server" "wait-on -t 30000 tcp:5000 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node electron/run.cjs"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "server,client,electron" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev" "wait-on -t 30000 tcp:5173 tcp:5000 && npm run electron:dev"
